pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection and chronic hippocampal imaging window implantation for PVBC axonal bouton imaging

parameters.virus: rAAV serotype 1 (rep/cap 2/1), Synapsin-GCaMP5-Cre, into dorsal CA1 of PV-TOM mice
parameters.implant_timing: chronic hippocampal imaging window implanted over left dorsal CA1, 2 weeks post-injection

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: PV-TOM mice with GCaMP5-expressing PV+ boutons and chronic imaging access

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging of PV+ basket-cell axonal boutons, including functional imaging during behavior and anatomical bouton-density z-stack imaging under anesthesia

parameters.functional_full_field: 256x128 px, 1.6 ms dwell, 2000-2400 frames, 165x165 um FOV, 7.63 Hz
parameters.functional_bouton_roi: 82x82 um or 41x41 um FOV, 9.7 Hz or 10.2 Hz
parameters.anatomical_zstack: ketamine/xylazine anesthesia, 82x82 um FOV, 512x512 px, 6 ms dwell, 100 frames, 3-6 mm z-stacks, superficial and deep locations
parameters.synchronization: custom-designed hardware/software for behavioral readout synchronized with imaging data

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: functional GCaMP5 bouton imaging data and anatomical bouton-density z-stacks

papers.title: Sublayer-Specific Coding Dynamics during Spatial Navigation and Learning in Hippocampal Area CA1.

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection for GCaMP6f expression in dorsal CA1

parameters.virus: rAAV1/2(CaMKII-GCaMP6f) for broad GCaMP6f expression in CA1 stratum pyramidale
parameters.delivery: Nanoject syringe, 60 nL (6x10 nL pulses) per site at three dorsoventral locations
parameters.coordinates: -2.3 mm AP, -1.5 mm ML, -0.9/-1.05/-1.2 mm DV relative to cortical surface

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice expressing GCaMP6f in CA1 pyramidal neurons

pipeline_steps.technique: Hippocampal imaging window and headpost implantation

parameters.window: 3.0-mm diameter, 1.5-mm height glass-bottomed steel cannula over left dorso-intermediate hippocampus, coverslip (64-0720, Warner) adhered with Norland optical adhesive
parameters.craniotomy: 3 mm craniotomy via fine-tipped dental drill; dura removed, cortex aspirated until external capsule fibers visible
parameters.headpost: stainless-steel headpost affixed with dental cement
parameters.recovery: mice active within 15 min post-surgery; analgesia continued 3 days postoperatively

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice with chronic hippocampal imaging window and headpost

pipeline_steps.technique: Random foraging (RF) behavioral training

parameters.reward_schedule: progressively restrictive schedule from 40 to 3 randomly placed rewards per lap over 1-2 weeks
parameters.criterion: 20 min daily until regularly running at least 1 lap/min

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice trained for random-foraging water reward on the treadmill

pipeline_steps.technique: Goal-oriented learning (GOL) behavioral training

parameters.operant_shaping: mice first trained to lick operantly at a capacitance-sensing water port, then required to advance the treadmill for reward eligibility (e.g. 5 steps forward = 5 s reward availability)
parameters.progressive_schedule: number, spatial extent, and time-limit of reward zones per lap gradually decreased until a single randomly placed 10 cm reward zone with a 3 s time limit

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice trained to run and lick for a randomly relocated reward zone

pipeline_steps.technique: Multisensory context construction and treadmill position-tracking system

parameters.contexts: contexts A and B share the same 3-fabric-ribbon treadmill belt order, distinguished by visual/auditory/tactile/olfactory stimuli; 6 tactile cues (silver glitter tape, green pompoms, velcro, glue-gun spikes, pink foam strips, jewels) shuffled in position between belts
parameters.position_tracking: RFID registration anchors (16 mm, 125 kHz, SparkFun) read by a fixed RFID reader (ID-12LA, SparkFun), interpolated using a quadrature-encoded movement signal from offset tick marks read by paired photodiodes (SparkFun SEN-0024), <0.5 cm resolution

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: multisensory context stimuli and continuous belt-position signal
pipeline_steps.hardware: RFID buttons and reader (SparkFun); photodiode quadrature encoder (SparkFun SEN-0024)

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo dual-plane (deep/superficial CA1) two-photon Ca2+ imaging acquisition

parameters.objective: 40x NIR water immersion, 0.8 NA, 3.5 mm WD (Nikon)
parameters.axial_toggling: piezoelectric crystal on the objective for rapid z-displacement between deep and superficial planes, separated by 25 microns; 40 ms settle time after each plane switch
parameters.head_alignment: two goniometers (±10°, Edmund Optics) used to align the CA1 pyramidal layer with the imaging plane
parameters.detection: emission cube set (green HQ525/70m-2p; red HQ607/45m-2p; 575dcxr, Chroma) to GaAsP PMT (Hamamatsu 7422P-40, green) and multi-alkali PMT (Hamamatsu R3896, red tdTomato)
parameters.acquisition: 2x digital zoom, 150x150 micron FOV, 512x512 pixels per plane, ~7 Hz effective dual-plane frame rate
parameters.superficial_plane_definition: first complete layer of CA1 PC somata above the stratum pyramidale/radiatum border (10-15 microns from border); deep plane 25 microns above

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw dual-plane two-photon Ca2+ fluorescence video
pipeline_steps.hardware: Bruker 8 kHz resonant scanner; Nikon 40x NIR objective; Hamamatsu GaAsP PMT 7422P-40 and R3896; Coherent 920 nm laser

pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction via modified 2D Hidden Markov Model with per-plane re-initialization

parameters.reinitialization: model re-initialized each plane to account for the 40 ms piezo settling time, permitting discontinuous displacements across planes
parameters.qc: data discarded when motion artifacts were not adequately corrected

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected imaging data

pipeline_steps.technique: Manual ROI segmentation and cross-session registration

parameters.segmentation: manual outlining of CA1 PC somata in ImageJ on time-averaged, motion-corrected images for one session per FOV
parameters.registration: polygons imported into SIMA and assigned unique labels; affine registration between the segmented session and each unsegmented session via SIMA's ROI Buddy GUI, applied to warp ROIs onto the target session, with minor post-hoc manual adjustment

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cross-session-registered somatic ROIs

pipeline_steps.technique: ΔF/F signal extraction with iterative baseline re-estimation and transient detection

parameters.df_f_calc: uniform smoothing window t1 = 3 s, baseline size t2 = 60 s
parameters.transient_definition: transient start = first frame with mean fluorescence >= 2σ of baseline SD; offset = first frame with mean fluorescence <= 0.5σ
parameters.iterative_refinement: baseline recalculated after masking frames identified during significant transients, ΔF/F and transients re-estimated; repeated 3 iterations to remove transient contamination from baseline
parameters.exclusion: transients shorter than 1 s removed as likely false positives

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: ΔF/F traces and detected Ca2+ transients per ROI

pipeline_steps.technique: Identification of spatially tuned cells via tuning specificity and spatial information

parameters.running_epoch_definition: consecutive forward-locomotion frames >=1 s duration with peak speed >=5 cm/s; epochs separated by <0.5 s merged
parameters.tuning_specificity: magnitude of the spatial tuning vector (1 - circular variance of occupancy-normalized transients); significance via 100,000 shuffles of transient onset times within running frames
parameters.spatial_information: Skaggs spatial information content computed across bin counts N = {2,4,5,8,10,20,25,100}; bias-corrected by subtracting the mean of 100,000 shuffled-onset null distributions; final estimate maximized over bin sizes for true and shuffled data
parameters.classification: cells classified as place cells separately by each metric based on shuffle-derived p-values

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: Ca2+ transient onset times restricted to running epochs
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified place cells with tuning specificity and spatial information scores

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-session remapping analysis: population vector correlation, centroid shift, and tuning curve correlation

parameters.rate_maps: 100 position bins, Gaussian-smoothed (σ = 3 bins), transients per bin normalized by occupancy
parameters.pv_correlation: 1D rate maps of all cells per sublayer stacked into population vectors; same-bin correlation averaged across bins between two sessions, all cells included regardless of tuning
parameters.centroid_shift: angle (radians) between spatial tuning vectors across sessions, restricted to cells classified as place cells by tuning specificity in both sessions
parameters.tuning_curve_correlation: Pearson correlation between rate maps across sessions, restricted to cells classified as place cells by spatial information in both sessions

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: cross-session rate maps and tuning vectors
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: PV correlation, centroid shift, and tuning curve correlation values

pipeline_steps.technique: Deep-vs-superficial task-modulation shuffle analysis (RF vs. GOL)

parameters.shuffle_1: null distribution of Δ task modulation from randomizing deep/superficial cell identity within each experiment (100,000 shuffles)
parameters.shuffle_2: null distribution from shuffling RF/GOL experiment identity while preserving each cell's sublayer identity (100,000 shuffles)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: significance of sublayer difference in task modulation

pipeline_steps.technique: Reward-representation-versus-performance regression and shuffle analysis

parameters.regression: linear regression of GOL task performance (fraction of licks in the reward zone) on covariates including day of experiment, fit by ordinary least squares
parameters.comparison_metric: absolute difference between correlation coefficients (r-values) for the two sublayers
parameters.null_model: null distribution of r-value differences from randomizing cell identity within each experiment and recomputing sublayer r-values (100,000 shuffles)

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-cell reward-zone representation strength and behavioral performance
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: regression coefficients and significance of sublayer difference in reward encoding

pipeline_steps.technique: Group-level statistical testing framework

parameters.primary_test: paired two-sample t-test wherever possible to compare population means across animals
parameters.nonparametric_alternative: Mann-Whitney U test when a paired t-test was not applicable
parameters.repeated_measures: ANOVA to compare behavior across sessions and days
parameters.aggregation: comparisons two-sided, data aggregated by mouse except where indicated

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: statistical significance results
